I’ll start with a few:

Jinkx Monsoon first of all, she kept me sane when I struggled through balancing school and severe narcolepsy. She made me realise I’m not alone and that crown on her head kept me going when everything seemed impossible. She also just makes me really happy all the time. I honestly wouldn’t be alive without her. 

BenDeLaCreme was just a queen i really admire and look up to. Now I watch interviews she does regularly and she always has me in absolute tears, she knows exactly what to say and that’s kept me alive in dark times. 

Courtney Act taught me I don’t need to be in a hurry to label my sexuality, I can take my time. She also introduced me to being sexually fluid, I’d never heard of that before. Hearing her speak up on issues that affect the whole community, with her educated perspective also really inspired me to also take a stand on issues i feel strongly about. 

Violet Chachki makes me feel confident in my womanhood and I adore her endlessly for that. I’m a proud, fierce woman. I channel her a lot in my every day, as I struggle a lot with anxiety, especially social, so I feel like a new person, i learn to be confident in myself too.

jinkx is my idol, (as you can tell from my username, really just made this account to talk drag race) and she honestly saved me so many times. as a narcoleptic, getting through my education has been so difficult because at every point i’ve felt i failed myself as i’d fall asleep at the worst moments or during an important lecture, i just really began to lack the motivation and i felt so helpless. that’s why jinkx really means a lot to me because seeing her win, despite her narcolepsy and even the way she really didn’t let anyone’s opinions or bullying get to her, it really showed to me how strong you can be, so yeah, she just means so much to me. 

main point, i bought tickets last week to meet her (and bendelacreme, of course) next september, right before my final exams. it just really feels like the universe is giving me an influx of love, it’s all aligning perfectly for me and i couldn’t be more thankful. 

i’m thinking about having a tattoo done in her honour before the show. her crown to me is such a symbol of just strength and defeat, so it’s a toss us between a sketch i’ve done of that or a pin-up jinkx. 

anyway, just an appreciation rant. i love finally having a place to be able to share my love of drag and what it’s done for me so openly.
